description: This file is a script for processing and generating content for a 'best practice' documentation system. It reads files, interacts with the OpenAI API to generate content, and writes updates to files based on certain conditions.

methods.name: getFilesInFolder
methods.description: Recursively reads a folder to list all files, returning a mapping of relative URLs to file paths.

methods.name: writeTopicContent
methods.description: Generates content for a given topic by calling the OpenAI API, formatted as a brief paragraph.

methods.name: writeFileForGroup
methods.description: Processes a group of topics, generating and writing content to associated files if they are empty.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates reading data, filtering groups, and processing files.
